title: Software Engineer
description: Designed, developed and maintained backend infrastructure for Microsoft Teams' Policy Administration platform. Modernized services to keep up with the growing demand for remote work and gained invaluable experience leveraging AI models from one of the leading companies in the space.

title: Software Engineer
description: Joined a brand new team chartered to create a PubSub SDK library designed to standardize message schemas for Teams Management Infrastructure. title: Software Engineer

title: Student Software Engineer
description: Owned and developed internal web apps and automations for Intel IT org.
